player_prompt.intro:
Wo rehyɛ Sokoban puzzle no mu. Wo ne player no, na wo hia sɛ wo tu boxes no nyinaa kɔ targets no so.
        Sɛ wo ne box no wɔ hɔ a, wo betumi atu no kɔ hɔ wɔ kwan no ara mu.
        Wo ntumi ntu box no fa wall no mu, na wo ntumi ntu box no.
        Wɔ board no so, nneɛma no yɛ: 
        - Player no (wo) pɛ sɛ 'P' 
        - Walls no yɛ '#' 
        - Boxes no yɛ 'X' 
        - Empty goals no yɛ 'O'
        - Boxes a wɔ goals no so yɛ '√'
        Wo betumi nso afa [w] sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kɔ soro, [a] sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kɔ benkum, [s] sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kɔ asase, na [d] sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kɔ nifa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nsiesie a wɔ de esiane nyɛ fɔm no mu. Fa [up], [down], [left], [right] anaa [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Akwankyerɛ a wɔde mae no nyɛ adwuma.
invalid_move.invalid_position: Nsakrae a enni mu - wontumi mfa nkɔ saa gyinabea no.

game_message.pushed_prefix: ɔtwee adaka bi mu bere a na

outcome.win: Mo ani agye! Woadi Sokoban asɛm no ho dwuma awie.
outcome.turn_limit: Woadu nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ no ho. Wuntumi mmua asɛmmisa no.
